title: UniGuard: Multi-View Guardrail Learning for Cross-Interface Safety Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.30742v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Guardrail models are increasingly used as safety layers for LLMs and agentic systems, but most are trained on fixed prompt or response interfaces and become unreliable when the same safety case appears as a conversation, agent trajectory, multi-agent trace, or policy-conditioned input. We propose UniGuard, a training framework that learns interface-invariant safety representations from multiple semantically aligned views of the same safety case. We also construct the UniGuard-FT dataset by transforming 1,000 public safety cases into prompt, response, multi-turn conversation, agent-trace, and multi-agent-trace views, and train UniGuard-0.6B with classification, supervised contrastive learning, and asymmetric confidence calibration losses. Across unseen-interface benchmarks ATBench, PolicyGuardBench, and DynaBench, UniGuard-0.6B improves over its pretrained guardrail by 45.12 F1 points on average and reduces expected calibration error by 3

translated_title: UniGuard：面向跨接口安全泛化的多视图护栏学习
translated_abstract: 护栏模型越来越多地被用作大语言模型（LLM）和智能体系统的安全层，但大多数护栏模型是在固定的提示或响应接口上训练的，当同一个安全案例以对话、智能体轨迹、多智能体追踪或策略条件输入等形式出现时，这些模型就会变得不可靠。我们提出了UniGuard，这是一个训练框架，它从同一个安全案例的多个语义对齐的视图中学习接口不变的安全表示。我们还构建了UniGuard-FT数据集，将1,000个公开安全案例转换为提示、响应、多轮对话、智能体轨迹和多智能体轨迹五种视图，并通过分类损失、监督对比学习和非对称置信度校准损失训练了UniGuard-0.6B模型。在未见过的接口基准测试ATBench、PolicyGuardBench和DynaBench上，UniGuard-0.6B相比其预训练护栏平均提升了45.12个F1点，并将期望校准误差降低了3（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: UniGuard提出了一种多视图护栏训练框架，通过将同一安全案例转换为提示、响应、多轮对话、智能体轨迹等多种对齐视图来学习接口不变的安全表示，使0.6B规模的护栏模型在未见过的接口上平均提升45.12个F1点并显著改善置信度校准。
